title: euphrasia litoralis
intro: Euphrasia litoralis, commonly known as the sea pink or marsh pink, is a species of flowering plant in the family Orobanchaceae. It is a perennial herb that has been traditionally used in herbal medicine to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Euphrasia litoralis include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which make it useful in treating conditions such as conjunctivitis, dry eyes, and respiratory infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include iridoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions of stimulating the immune system, reducing inflammation, and protecting against oxidative stress.
